items.title: A space is Hausdorff exactly when its diagonal is closed in the product
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the diagonal criterion for the Hausdorff property (author lemma at source lines 339-346, label lemma-Hausdorff). The proof (source lines 348-362) is a direct two-way argument whose converse direction carries the content: from the closedness of the diagonal the author takes a basic product neighbourhood of an off-diagonal pair and trims its two factors to obtain disjoint neighbourhoods of the two points (proof lines 353-361). The criterion is used later in the chapter when the Hausdorff property has to be checked on products. H2.
